discovery_notes: Follow-up 3 of B044 (cell B322); reuses keys from packets 105, 402, 449, 482. 27 WebSearch calls, all snippet-level (snippets are search-engine summaries). New per-pin evidence: Jungle Festival LE 500 eight (dein-dlrp overview, previously reseller-only), Brave Merida bow/wisp (resolves bears conflict), Mickey flag heads five (Oct 2020), Aristocats Oct 2020, Stitch Aug 2021 OE four, Stitch small world. Corroboration: Big Thunder OE EUR 10, Pocahontas Sep 2020 Disney Gallery, BatB OE prices/24 Jul, Alice EUR 17. Holds unchanged. No instructional content seen.
